title: VisionIQ event envelope v1 (S03-01)
description: Every event exchanged between the .NET and Python services. Event-specific schemas narrow event_type, schema_version and data, and close the object with unevaluatedProperties.

event_id.description: Unique per logical event; consumers deduplicate on it.

schema_version.description: Major version of the data contract. A consumer rejects versions it does not know.

tenant_id.description: Tenant / security scope the event belongs to.

correlation_id.description: Business correlation (usually the run). Stays the same for every event of one request.

trace_id.description: W3C trace ID (32 lowercase hex), logged by every service that touches the event.

source_revision.description: Revision of the source artifact the event was derived from, when there is one.

scope.description: An access principal, e.g. ado-project:{organization URL}/{project}. Azure DevOps project names may contain single spaces between words.
